title: HPT Cars and Coffee in the COVE Cruise In
venue: 6511 Highway 431 S, Owens Cross Roads, AL 35763-9217, United States
description:
Casual Cars & Coffee meet in Hampton Cove / Owen's Cross Roads area with the HPT team and Dunkin'.  

This will be every Saturday, rain or shine, and the first Saturday of each month, we'll use it as a meeting spot before cruising up to the Mid-City C&C.

Cruise in, grab a cup of coffee and a donut, hang out, talk about cars/trucks/bike/anything that propels you down the road, tell stories (lies), and enjoy each other’s company.

One of the primary missions of Horsepower Therapy is to provide methods and opportunities for veterans and families to be around cars and experience the benefit of horsepower therapy. 

What better way, locally, then to have a place to meet, greet, and be a community of veteran car owners.

Maybe you need help with a project (more to come on a new Horsepower Therapy Garage), maybe you could use some advice on a project, or maybe you just want to show off. Ultimately, it’s not about what you drive, it’s that you showed up to have some fun!

Come on out, stay for a little bit or stay for a while!
Let your friends know!!!

title: Swede Sunday - 4th annual
description:
The 4th Annual Swede Sunday is coming up! 

Come hang out with fellow enthusiasts who love their Volvos and Swedish cars! Whether you’ve got a pristine show car, a project that’s still a work in progress, or just an appreciation for all things Swedish, you’re welcome here.

We’ll kick things off with our initial car show, giving everyone plenty of time to walk around, check out the cars, and meet other enthusiasts. Once the show wraps up, we’ll hit the road for a cruise through some of the local back roads, enjoying the cars and the scenery together.

Come out, bring your Volvo (or any Swedish car), and spend a Sunday with people who understand these unique vehicles
